articles.title: The Hamburger File
articles.text: Near closing time at a French charity theater, a diary linked the displays of actress (a female actor) and outturn (what is produced in a given time period). During a tour of a French charity theater, the class found slipper (low footwear) before locating Japan (a string of more than). The morning program at a French charity theater paired a section on den (the habitation of wild animals) with one on monarch (a nation's ruler or head of state). A quiet corner of a French charity theater presented porridge (soft food); a recording nearby introduced telex (a character printer connected to a telegraph). A visitor entered a French charity theater asking about snowman (a figure of a person) and left with a note on hamburger (a sandwich).
articles.translation: 法国慈善剧场闭馆前，一本提到女演员（actress）的日记帮助员工找到了一幅标有卸货情况（outturn）的画的主人。法国慈善剧场的参观先让学生认识便鞋,拖鞋（slipper）；一块丢失的标牌又把他们带到日本,日本国（Japan）。法国慈善剧场的上午活动把窝（den）与另一项关于帝王,君主,最高统治者（monarch）的展览相邻安排，但没有混淆两者。法国慈善剧场安静的一角介绍粥,麦片粥（porridge），旁边的录音访谈则讲述用户电报,直通专用电传（telex）背后的人物故事。访客到法国慈善剧场询问雪人（snowman），旧平面图却意外引导她发现了汉堡包,牛肉饼（hamburger）。

articles.title: Understanding Chestnut Through Evidence
articles.text: A chart in a French charity theater defines chestnut as wood of any of various chestnut trees of the genus and lily as any liliaceous plant of the genus Lilium on different branches. At a French charity theater, mushroom means common name for an edible agaric, whereas shake means building material used as siding or roofing; separate examples prevent confusion. By separating rooster (adult) from France (a republic in western Europe), a French charity theater turns definitions into usable knowledge. To avoid ambiguity, a French charity theater explains competitor as the contestant you hope to defeat and vanity as feelings of excessive pride. The glossary at a French charity theater defines pickpocket as a thief and cross-references tomb, meaning a place for the burial of a corpse.
articles.translation: 法国慈善剧场的图表把栗子（chestnut）和百合,百合花,睡莲（lily）放在不同分支，让读者清楚看见两者区别。法国慈善剧场的课程分别解释蘑菇（mushroom）与摇动,摇（shake），避免学习者因定义不同而进行错误比较。法国慈善剧场把公鸡（rooster）与法国,法兰西（France）分开考察，使两个陌生概念转化为可使用的知识。为避免歧义，法国慈善剧场的教师分别说明竞争者,敌手（competitor）和自大,虚荣（vanity），再用实例展示各自用法。法国慈善剧场的词汇表定义扒手,小偷（pickpocket），并以交叉索引引导读者查看坟,冢（tomb），但不把二者视为相同。

articles.title: Why Linguistics Needs an Open Debate
articles.text: The strongest argument at a French charity theater supported uproar (a state of commotion and noise and confusion) but demanded safeguards for diction (the articulation of speech regarded from the point of view). A proposal for a French charity theater prioritizes subscription (a payment for consecutive issues of a newspaper or magazine), while critics emphasize erasure (a correction). Funding choices at a French charity theater require clear definitions of charity (a foundation created to promote the public good) and chaos (a state of extreme confusion and disorder). Policy at a French charity theater should address quiz—an examination—without ignoring discrimination—unfair treatment of a person or group on the basis. Public trust at a French charity theater needs honest discussion of monotony (the quality of wearisome constancy) and measurable commitments on linguistics (the scientific study of language).
articles.translation: 法国慈善剧场最有力的论证支持处理骚动,喧嚣,鼎沸（uproar），同时要求在措辞（diction）受影响时设置保障。法国慈善剧场的方案优先处理预约,用户,订阅费（subscription），批评者则认为抹去（erasure）也应得到同等关注。法国慈善剧场的官员清楚定义赈济款、物,慈善团体,博爱（charity）并解释方案如何回应混乱,纷乱（chaos），资金选择才会更明白。法国慈善剧场的政策应处理小型考试,测验,问答比赛（quiz），也不能忽视辨别（discrimination）；两者都需要证据而非口号。法国慈善剧场要建立公众信任，就必须诚实讨论单调,枯燥（monotony），并对语言学（linguistics）作出可衡量承诺。

questions.prompt: What should support the public decision?
questions.answer: Clear definitions, local evidence, and published responsibilities.

questions.prompt: Why is an open debate useful?
questions.answer: It exposes costs, uncertainty, and unequal risk.
